scheme_name: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Waiver of Electricity Duty
other_conditions: Must be a micro, small or medium enterprise in the powerloom sector
Must have started production between 01-01-2022 and 31-12-2024
Must execute a four‑party agreement with the Directorate of Textiles, a financial institution and Tantuja
Must be a private sector, cooperative sector, joint sector undertaking, or a company/undertaking owned and managed by the State Government or Industrial SHGs
Must have a detailed feasibility report/project prepared for the purpose
Project must be approved and sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution, Commercial Bank or State Financial Institution
benefits_summary: Provides a waiver on electricity duty for up to 5 years, with the percentage and maximum amount varying by enterprise size and zone (up to ₹10 lakhs per year for micro/small enterprises and up to ₹25 lakhs per year for medium enterprises).
